purpose: Regression test: a different but unrelated third-party domain must not automatically be classified as lookalike spoofing.

generation_context.organization_context: Windropolis uses an external vendor for file-transfer maintenance.

evaluation_context.situation_context: A legitimate external vendor may contact IT about file-transfer maintenance.

steps: Click Evaluate Email and fill the manual context.
Set Link usage to Used with vendor-lab.test and expected domain windropolis.corporate.
Set No attachments and run evaluation.
expected_invariants: The unrelated vendor domain is not treated as lookalike spoofing solely because it differs from windropolis.corporate.
The sender identity remains consistent with the Vendor Support narrative.
Any positive cue must have a semantic reason beyond simple domain inequality.
